title: Analyze all data, in any format
content: ClickHouse provides support for 70+ [file formats](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/sql-reference/formats) - from Parquet to JSON, CSV, TSV, and many more. For local files, [clickhouse-local](/blog/extracting-converting-querying-local-files-with-sql-clickhouse-local) provides a powerful and portable tool to query, convert and transform data on your local machine, too.

title: Integrate with your favorite tools
content: Our vibrant and growing ecosystem of integrations makes it easy to leverage the tools and frameworks you already love - from MySQL-compatible tools, to popular visualization products like Tableau, as well as language clients, dbt, [and many more](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/integrations).

title: Reduce cost and maximize efficiency
content: Many traditional data warehouses charge per query, limit concurrency, and gate critical features behind higher pricing tiers. With ClickHouse, speed comes out-of-the box. And, you only pay for the compute and compressed storage you actually use.

title: Simplify your SQL
content: ClickHouse supports an extensive library of domain-specific functions that scale seamlessly over billions of records, and transform even the most complex queries into simple SQL statements. With ClickHouse, data exploration is easy and powerful.
